selection_protocol.development: Scalarization families, controller settings, and training budgets are declared before test evaluation.
selection_protocol.test: Evaluate every declared preference point once; do not select a preference from test metrics.
selection_protocol.claim: A successful sweep demonstrates preference control or Pareto non-dominance, not universal metric dominance.

preference_response_criterion.recovery: recovery focus minus zero focus has positive nonzero-recovery delta
preference_response_criterion.mae: MAE focus minus zero focus has positive nonzero-MAE-benefit delta
preference_response_criterion.zero: zero focus minus recovery focus has positive zero-accuracy delta

dcm.radar_scale_note: Zoomed display ranges frozen on development data; native values and intervals are reported separately.

genmol.preference_response_criterion: QED focus minus SA focus has positive QED delta and negative SA-benefit delta; the corresponding one-sided bounds of both 95% bootstrap intervals must exclude zero
